pcs.pc_description: check the delivered produce to ensure it is in good condition and delivery matches with the purchase order
ensure safe handling of produce by workers at the ripening chamber
report any discrepancies in the delivery or quality issues in the produce to the relevant person
identify and sort out the unsuitable fruits from the fruit lots
determine the ripening stage of the fruits
use the appropriate type of fruit boxes for the ripening operation
set the fruits boxes on pallets appropriately to allow ethylene gas to pass from the periphery of the fruits
create air pockets in the fruit boxes for optimum air circulation in the boxes
ensure fruits boxes are hauled in the ripening chamber using the appropriate equipment, e.g. hauler
follow the appropriate ripening procedure according to the quality requirements and marketer’s instructions
ensure optimum utilization of space in the ripening chamber
follow the recommended practices to protect fruits from contamination during ripening
ensure appropriate storage of fruits with the help of relevant tools, equipment and accessories, e.g. use of pallets and crates to protect fruits from contamination
circulate the recommended dose of ethylene gas in the ripening chamber
maintain the recommended levels of temperature, humidity, oxygen and CO2 concentration during ripening operations
ensure fruits are weighed accurately and packed appropriately
use the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and follow the recommended practices to ensure personal safety during ripening operations
ensure the ripening chamber workers follow the recommended safety measures, such as the use of relevant PPE to avoid direct contact with ethylene gas and liquid
follow the appropriate fire safety measures in the ripening chamber

pcs.pc_description: check the ripening chamber to ensure intact insulation on the walls
ensure optimum air-circulation and ventilation in the ripening chamber and carry out repair and maintenance of the ventilation system, as required
check the ethylene gas injection system for appropriate functioning and carry out its maintenance as required
check the air temperature and humidity control system for the correct functioning and carry out repair and maintenance for any issues identified
inspect the electrical controlling equipment for the correct functioning and perform maintenance, if required
check the ripening chamber doors for appropriate sealing and carry out maintenance as required
check the electronic devices, sensors and temperature controllers for the correct functioning
follow the appropriate measures to prevent the leakage of ethylene gas from the ripening chamber and take appropriate remedial measures to deal with ethylene gas leakage
check the ripening chamber’s physical structure to identify the repair and maintenance needs, e.g. cracks in the walls
carry out regular infrastructural repair and maintenance and coordinate with an expert to resolve any complex issues
clean and sanitize equipment and chamber surfaces regularly to meet hygiene standards
maintain logs of chamber settings, product batches, and ripening times
document any changes or anomalies in the process
collect the relevant data and prepare appropriate datasheets and reports concerning the ripening chamber operations and maintenance
ensure all the relevant data is maintained in the appropriate format and is available to the relevant stakeholders to review
follow optimal stacking and spacing practices to ensure efficient airflow and reduce load on refrigeration systems
minimize frequent opening of chamber doors and use air curtains/PVC strip curtains to prevent cooling losses
operate during off-peak electricity hours if possible
follow scheduled preventive maintenance for refrigeration units, coils, insulation, door seals, and fans
monitor and record energy usage data and identify deviations for corrective action

modules.module_title: Follow Sustainable and Eco-friendly Ripening Practices

pcs.pc_description: use low GWP (Global Warming Potential) refrigerants to enhance energy efficiency and sustainability
segregate waste and reduce fruit spoilage through proper sorting and FIFO/FEFO practices
use reusable crates, environmentally safe cleaning materials, and minimize single-use plastics
collect and manage waste water safely and use water-efficient cleaning practices
use rejected heat from condensers for water heating or dehumidification
maintain environmental compliance records (gas logs, waste logs, maintenance sheets) and follow HACCP/GMP norms
